# Portable GRASS Runtime

This package contains the portable GRASS GIS 8.5.0 runtime under `runtime\grass`.

## License

GRASS GIS is licensed under the GNU General Public License, version 2 or later. When redistributing the runtime, retain its original license files and provide the corresponding source or applicable written source offer.

- Project site: <https://grass.osgeo.org/>
- Source repository: <https://github.com/OSGeo/grass>

The original `COPYING` and other license files are kept in the `runtime\grass` directory.
